findings: The confirming decision is the latest point in the spec, and the confirming target is target_point:target_field. An earlier declared point is rejected before the query. A free-text target cannot take a scientific pass. A Y900 card on a spec whose latest point is Y900 keeps the ordinary classification path.

Declaring X300 on a spec that also uses Y900 writes nothing. A liquidity label repeated by the card does not become a scientific pass. A card at Y900 with the measured target reaches PASS_DATA_OPTION_REQUIRED through Critic.

The confirming moment and target come from the validated spec. X300 is not stored when Y900 is the latest decision point. A free-text target stays unbound. The measured Y900 scope can still reach ordinary classification.
The readout names the latest decision point and the measured target point and field. A match keeps the ordinary path. No new manual step and no market forge claim.

remediation_history.finding: A card-only decision moment could still LOOK_SCOPE_MATCH when the stored look lacked that axis.
The positive Critic path used only a singleton X300 spec, so the latest point of a two-point look was not shown through classification.
The readout named a different decision moment and a separate scope contradiction, and did not name population as the same machine stop.
